Container.Name: garmin-intervals-bridge
Container.Overview: Garmin to Intervals.icu bridge: puts back what Garmin strips from the FIT files it sends to Intervals.icu (Stamina, Recovery Time, VO2max, Training Effect ...), syncs the daily wellness data the official sync misses, and your Garmin gear. It starts as a dry run (Post Arguments: run); once its log looks right, change Post Arguments to: run --apply. Sign in to Garmin once in the container's console: garmin-intervals-bridge login. Guide: docs/UNRAID.md in the project.

Config.Name: Intervals.icu API key
Config.Description: Intervals.icu: Settings, Developer Settings, API key

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone (Region/City): which date last night's sleep belongs to

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Garmin session, original FIT files, daily archive. Private. Must be writable for user id 10001.

Config.Name: ImReady4 training advice
Config.Description: true: fill the TrainingAdvice wellness field each morning (docs/IMREADY4.md)

Config.Name: HRV trend advice (experimental)
Config.Description: true: an advice from the 7-day HRV trend into its own field (docs/HRV_TREND.md)
